85:1: And by the sky, it is the possessor of constellations.
85:3: By a witness and what is witnessed.
85:4: The companions of the ditch were destroyed.
85:5: To the fire, possessor of fuel.
85:7: They bear witness to what they did to the believers.
85:8: They did not take revenge on them, except because they believed in Allah, Who is al-Aziz and al-Hamid.
85:9: He that the dominion of the heavens and the earth is His alone, and Allah is a witness over all things.
85:10: Indeed, for those who subjected believing men and believing women to trial and then did not repent, there is the punishment of Hell and the punishment of the burning fire.
85:11: Indeed, for those who believe and do righteous deeds, there are gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great success.
85:12: Indeed, the seizure of your Rabb is severe.
85:13: Indeed, He is the One Who originates and repeats.
85:14: And He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Loving.
85:15: The possessor of the Throne is glorious.
85:16: The Doer of what He wills.
85:17: Did the news of the armies come to you?
85:19: Rather, those who disbelieve are denying.
85:21: Rather, it is a glorious Qur'an.
85:22: In the Preserved Tablet, it is a protected Qur'an.
